ten_goi.chu: Saturn is named after the Roman god of wealth and agriculture, who was the father of the god Jupiter.

moc.chu: Saturn's mythological reign was depicted as a Golden Age of abundance and peace.
The potential cruelty of Saturn was enhanced by his identification with Cronus, known for devouring his own children.
As a result, although he sired the gods Demeter, Hestia, Hera, Hades, and Poseidon by Rhea, he devoured them all as soon as they were born to prevent the prophecy.
Rhea kept Zeus hidden in a cave on Mount Ida, Crete.
According to Hesiod, once Zeus had grown up, Cronus was forced to regurgitate his children through Gaia's cunning and Zeus's might.
In a vast war called the Titanomachy, Zeus and his older brothers and sisters, with the help of the Hecatoncheires and Cyclopes, overthrew Cronus and the other Titans.
